summary: Tested 4 new session features for Valhalla Dragons/Skægagamer app: (1) unlimited dragons (MAX_DRAGONS cap removed), (2) schedule-slot delete-scope confirm dialog with 'Slet kun denne dag'/'Slet for alle ugedage'/'Annuller', (3) page_title_color applied to Dagsoversigt date nav + dragon name + progress text, (4) Ugeplaner active day chip light-gray (#D9D6D2) styling. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py (3/3 tests passing) - verified 7 dragons created past old cap of 5 with no 400 error, DELETE /api/schedule-slots/{id}?all_days=true bulk-deletes only matching age_category+time_id+category slots across days while leaving different-category slots untouched, single delete (no all_days param) still removes only 1 slot (regression pass), and page_title_color persists via PUT/GET /api/admin/settings. Frontend (mobile viewport 375x667, Playwright): verified dragons-count testID shows 'N af N' format (confirmed '1 af 1' then '6 af 6' after creating 5 extra dragons via API), add-dragon-fab stays visible past 5 dragons; confirmed 3-stacked-button confirm-sheet renders exactly as spec ('Slet kun denne dag'/'Slet for alle ugedage'/'Annuller') when opening delete on a schedule slot with onSecondaryConfirm set; performed live single-day delete (only mandag slot removed, tirsdag/onsdag/torsdag matches untouched) then live bulk all-days delete (removed 3 remaining matching slots, toast showed 'Opgave slettet for 3 ugedage', verified all 3 gone via UI); confirmed active day chip background rgb(217,214,210)=#D9D6D2 for both mandag and tirsdag when selected; set page_title_color=#8E7DBE via Admin>App-udseende (admin-page-title-color-#8E7DBE testID + admin-appearance-save-button), verified via computed styles that Dagsoversigt date-nav text, dragon-column-name, and dragon-column-progress texts all rendered rgb(142,125,190)=#8E7DBE. Cleaned up all test dragons/slots and reset admin settings to null after testing.

issues: Same non-blocking observation as prior iteration: choosing the same/similar page_title_color and app_bg_color (e.g. both #8E7DBE purple) makes the date-nav text, dragon name, and progress text nearly invisible against the background. This is an expected consequence of matching colors, not a functional bug in this session's feature, but still worth a contrast-check nudge in Admin UI at some point.

action_items: No blocking issues found for any of the 4 requested changes - all implemented correctly matching the spec.

Optional: consider a contrast warning in Admin > App-udseende when app_bg_color and page_title_color are identical/very similar, since it affects visibility on Dagsoversigt, Agamer, and Ugeplaner headers/text (not required for this round's scope).
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/dragons.py: MAX_DRAGONS cap fully removed from create_dragon - no validation blocking creation, confirmed via 7 sequential creates with 200 status.

backend/routes/schedule_slots.py delete_schedule_slot: all_days=true branch correctly queries by age_category+time_id+category, deletes matches + their completions, returns deleted_count; default branch preserved for regression (single slot + its completions only).

frontend/context/OverlayContext.tsx: showConfirm cleanly extended with optional onSecondaryConfirm/secondaryLabel/secondaryDestructive - renders 3-button stacked layout (confirmActionsColumn) only when secondary handler present, falls back to original 2-button row otherwise. Good backward-compatible design (used elsewhere e.g. dragon delete still shows 2 buttons).

frontend/app/(tabs)/schedule.tsx handleDeleteSlot: onConfirm calls DELETE without all_days, onSecondaryConfirm calls DELETE with ?all_days=true and surfaces deleted_count in toast - matches spec exactly.

frontend/components/DragonColumn.tsx + app/(tabs)/index.tsx: pageTitleColor correctly threaded through to name/progress/date-nav text styles via useAdminSettings hook, consistent with existing pattern used for page title text.
frontend/app/(tabs)/schedule.tsx dayChipActive style: backgroundColor #D9D6D2 / borderColor #B8B4AF with dark textPrimary color for dayChipTextActive - confirmed rendering as light gray, not black.
seed_data_creation: None left behind. All TEST_ prefixed dragons and test schedule slots created during testing were deleted; admin app_bg_color/page_title_color reset to null after verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: This session covered only the 4 new changes described (unlimited dragons, delete-scope dialog, page_title_color extension to Dagsoversigt/DragonColumn, Ugeplaner day chip color). Not retested this round: full regression of dragon/task CRUD basics, bulk-copy-to-days feature, banner customization (all previously passing per iteration 1-5 context and assumed stable since untouched by this session's diff).
rca_of_issue: N/A - no bugs found for any of the 4 requested features; all implementations matched the spec exactly.
